About me

I'm a Computer Science and Information Sciences graduate, finishing in November 2026 with a 90% aggregate, a BCom in Law, and membership of the Golden Key Society.

I build full stack applications using clean code, test-driven development and CI/CD practices, across .NET, TypeScript and Angular, SQL and NoSQL databases, and Azure. I'm currently leading a client Work-Integrated Learning project as team lead and lead developer, and I've added training in application security, business intelligence and Power BI.

My classmates elected me class representative in every year of both degrees, and I communicate confidently with internal and external stakeholders. My legal training adds analytical thinking and attention to detail, which suits compliance-sensitive and contract-heavy systems.

I'm looking for a full stack developer role where I can keep growing as a software developer.
